newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 1,590-1,600 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat at 1,590-1,600 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,590-1,600 per dollar on Tuesday, unchanged from the opening and the previous close on a quiet interbank market with foreign currency demand low, dealers said.
"The lev idled close to opening levels throughout the day as foreign currency demand was low," said a dealer.
Dealers said that the central bank was seen absorbing part of the higher dollar supply, buying small volumes at market levels. Central bank officials declined comment.
Traders said the lev was likely to trade range bound on Wednesday again as dollar supply was expected to top demand. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
